query:
SELECT rm.id, rm.name, rm.category, COUNT(rmm.id) as mol_count 
FROM raw_materials rm 
LEFT JOIN raw_material_molecules rmm ON rm.id = rmm.raw_material_id
WHERE rm.category IN ('absolue', 'extrait_co2')
GROUP BY rm.id, rm.name, rm.category
HAVING mol_count < 3
LIMIT 20;
